name: reviews
_comment_purpose: The agent's structured review of one request revision, written by review_request (or seeded, with reviewer_session_id `seed`). One row per run, keyed rev_{request_id}_{revision}_{created_at ms}, so a re-review or a resubmission keeps the earlier rows; the request's `review_id` names the latest. `checks` are the review items ({name: role|segregation|duration|justification, status: pass|flag|fail, note}); `issues` is the plain-language list of what must be resolved before a grant.
